name: NARFD with Autoencoder for Appearance Variation
definition: An autoencoder built on NARF to model shape and appearance variation among multiple articulated objects, consisting of a 2D CNN-based encoder and an NARF-based decoder.
summary: NARFD with Autoencoder for Appearance Variation extends the NARFD framework by using a 2D CNN-based autoencoder to model shape and appearance variations across multiple articulated objects, enabling single-view reconstruction and independent control of pose and color.
